portInfo.description: Bimini’s small scale can make maps misleading:North and South Bimini are distinct islands, and marine sights add a boat dependency. Dolphin House in Alice Town is Ashley Saunders’ artistic house of found/recycled materials, not a captive-dolphin encounter. The Bahamas Tourism museum listing currently says closed for renovation, so no itinerary assumes an interior visit. Resorts World’s property page puts Bimini Beach’s normal opening at 11:00–18:00 and says non-hotel guests need a day pass; private events and seasonal operation can change access. The complimentary tram links the cruise/resort facilities, but does not establish a guaranteed frequency, a universal Virgin-branded beach entitlement or free use of hotel pools.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Dolphin House, Dolphin House, Alice Town, North Bimini: Ashley Saunders’ found-materials art house and local creative history. Allow about 60 minutes (editorial estimate). Confirm guided entry/hours; it is not a dolphin swim.

Radio Beach, Radio Beach, Alice Town, North Bimini: A town-side beach alternative to the resort club. Allow about 120 minutes (editorial estimate). Agree a named driver meeting/access point; swimming depends on current sea conditions.

Fisherman’s Village, Fisherman’s Village beside the Hilton lobby/marina, Resorts World, North Bimini: A specifically located marina/retail/refreshment pause near resort facilities. Allow about 60 minutes (editorial estimate). Not every retail or hotel facility is included with a cruise visit.

Bimini Beach, Bimini Beach, Resorts World, North Bimini: A bookable beach-club day if the correct sailing/pass has access. Allow about 180 minutes (editorial estimate). Published hours 11:00–18:00 read 5 November 2026; private events/seasonal operations may close it. Admission not automatically included.

Sapona wreck, Sapona offshore wreck, Bimini; meet at the licensed marine operator’s confirmed dock: A conditional guided marine-history/snorkel outing. Allow about 180 minutes (editorial estimate). Exact boat meeting point unresolved; requires weather/fitness assessment and cannot be reached on foot.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Reserve the exact beach entitlement for your ship, and keep a free-to-enter shore-view alternative if a private event closes the club. A complimentary tram is transport, not admission.
